parameters.name: Motor I2t temperature reaction

modbus_registers.name: Supported Function Codes
modbus_registers.description: FC3 - Read Holding Registers (FC = 0x03); FC6 - Write Single Register (FC = 0x06); FC16 - Write Multiple Registers (FC = 0x10, page 139). Page 140: only FC3, FC6 and FC16 are supported. Read request of too many registers (>125) and write request of too many registers (>123) return exception code 03.
modbus_registers.evidence_quote: The SINAMICS V20 supports only three Function Codes.

modbus_registers.name: Mapping table (register sets)
modbus_registers.description: Registers map to specific parameters listed in the mapping table (Read/Write columns). No general rule for addressing arbitrary parameters as registers was found. Scaling: a parameter with decimal places is multiplied by the scaling factor in the table (page 145).
modbus_registers.evidence_quote: The SINAMICS V20 inverter supports two sets of registers (40001 to 40062, 40100 to 40522) as the table below shows.
